text: Write the opening to a story called The Longest Day of My Life. In your writing, create a sense of
mood and drama.
Write two contrasting pieces (300–450 words each), the first about a person living in the
countryside, and the second about the same person living in a city a year later. In your writing,
create a sense of atmosphere and place.
Write a descriptive piece about an airport. In your writing, create a sense of atmosphere, and
focus on sounds and movements to help your reader imagine the scene.
Section B: Writing for an audience
In class, you have been discussing the pros and cons of being famous. Write an article for your
school magazine called Fame – Is it worth it? In your writing, show your interest in this issue.
A new computer game has recently become available. Write two contrasting reviews (300–450
words each), which will be published on a technology website. One of the reviews praises the new
computer game, and the other criticises it.
Your school is going to hold an evening for students and parents celebrating the creative and
expressive arts. The evening will include a talk by a teacher about the many benefits of taking up
a creative or expressive hobby. Write the text of the talk. |n your writing, create a sense of passion
and enthusiasm for creativity and/or expression.
